$description: Design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the design system. Edit values here only -- do not hand-edit the generated src/index.css or src/generated/tokens.ts. The dev server regenerates them on every change (scripts/build-tokens.mjs, wired through vite.config.ts). Colors are authored as hex; the generator converts them to `H S% L%` channels for the web theme and keeps hex for mobile (tokens.ts). Every color role exists in both light and dark. Dark palette: Nocturne design system (Metrix v1 design handoff) -- #161826 ground, #232532 surfaces, #9184d9 blurple accent used as line/glow (never flood fill), status colors from the prototype's --mx-* block. Dark is the source-native mode (the IAP pins class=dark); light remains the earlier Command Deck derivative until a Nocturne light theme is designed.

primary.$description: Signal blue (light-mode derivative of the deck's #38bdf8 accent-blue).

background.$description: Nocturne page ground (--color-bg, Metrix v1 design handoff).

border.$description: Nocturne container/card edge (--mx-edge from the Metrix v1 prototype).

popover.$description: One ramp step above surface (Nocturne --color-neutral-900) for elevated sub-panels.

primary.$description: Nocturne blurple accent (--color-accent). Used as line/glow, never a flood fill.

secondary.$description: Accent-tinted dark fill (Nocturne --color-accent-900) for selected/hover states.

muted.$description: Derived midpoint between Nocturne ground and surface (sticky table headers).

mutedForeground.$description: Nocturne --color-neutral-500; visually matches the prototype's --mx-dim role.

input.$description: Nocturne structural-chrome edge (--mx-edge-strong) for interactive borders.

chart3.$description: Success teal. Nocturne semantics put 'good' on cyan, but chart3 doubles as --mx-success in the IAP theme and must stay distinct from chart2's cyan; teal keeps the family.

chart4.$description: Metrix v1 prototype --mx-warn (chart4 doubles as --mx-warning in the IAP theme).

sidebar.$description: Nav shell one step deeper than the Nocturne ground (derived, hue-consistent).

sidebarBorder.$description: Nocturne dense-rule edge (--mx-edge-soft): list separators, rail dividers.

sans.$description: Default UI and body typeface (source: Command Deck mockup).

mono.$description: Terminal readout face used for labels, metrics, and codes.

base.$description: Nocturne corner scale (Metrix v1 handoff: sm 4px / md 8px / lg 14px). The theme template derives sm = base - 4px and lg = base, so 0.5rem lands sm/md on Nocturne's 4px/8px steps; xl (base + 4px) approximates Nocturne's 14px large radius.
